entries.title: Faster session search
entries.summary: Find conversations sooner after signing in or adding a device.
entries.markdown:
- Search results appear while large conversation histories continue indexing.
- Completed search progress stays in place during background refreshes.
- Reopening the app reuses your encrypted search history.

entries.title: Run workflows in your project folder
entries.summary: Start workflows in ordinary folders, including workspaces containing several repositories.
entries.markdown:
- Use folders with no Git repository or first commit, and keep your uncommitted work.
- See whether a run works directly in your folder or in an isolated Git worktree.
- Update your machine CLI to use this improvement.

entries.title: A clearer way to run workflows
entries.summary: Create reusable agent teams and follow their work from planning through review. Enable Workflows in Experimental Features to try it.
entries.markdown:
- Find saved workflows and recent runs in a dedicated Workflows library.
- Create a workflow in four focused steps: Basics, Team, Finish, and Review.
- Add and reorder stages, with up to three planners or reviewers per stage. Choose each agent's provider, model, effort, and instructions.
- Run a saved workflow with a prompt, a machine, and the familiar project picker.
- Read the agreed plan, follow agent progress, and inspect reviews and completion checks. Clear recovery actions help you continue when a run needs attention.
- Keep fields and actions within reach while typing on your phone.

entries.title: Your agents, working together
entries.summary: Build experimental workflows with Codex, Claude, and Muse Code agents.
entries.markdown:
- Choose a provider, model, and effort for each agent.
- Edit agents in a focused panel while keeping your stages easy to scan.
- Mix planners, executors, and reviewers across providers.
- Update your machine CLI to use multi-provider workflows.

entries.title: Editable workflows
entries.summary: Build a workflow around your own planning, execution, and review stages. Enable Workflows in Experimental Features to try it.
entries.markdown:
- Add, remove, and reorder stages.
- Choose up to three planners or reviewers and one executor per stage.
- Create agents while editing, and customize instructions and completion checks.
- Update your machine CLI to use the new workflows.

entries.title: Resume after migration
entries.summary: Resume older conversations automatically on the same computer after moving from Happy to Talos.

entries.title: Resume and background search
entries.summary: Resume archived conversations directly from the app. Search indexes automatically as you use Talos and can refresh while the app is in the background.

entries.title: Search result fixes
entries.summary: Open archived search results when connected to an older server.

entries.title: Search your sessions
entries.summary: Find past conversations by title and the messages you sent.
entries.markdown:
- Search active sessions and archives with a message in the last 90 days.
- Include agent replies or search older history when you need more.
- Tap a matching excerpt to jump straight to that message.

entries.title: Muse session tools
entries.markdown:
- Muse tool calls use compact progress rows. Tap a row to inspect its details.
- Muse task plans appear in the shared task panel and survive resume and terminal handoff.
- Muse can name and rename chats and share local images through Talos session tools.

entries.title: Muse Code controls
entries.summary: Choose how Muse works from your phone, browser, or terminal.
entries.markdown:
- Select every native effort level, from none through ultra.
- Choose untrusted actions, on-request approvals, never-prompt, bypass approvals, or YOLO.
- Keep your selected controls when resuming or moving between Talos and the native terminal.
- Model changes remain disabled to preserve conversation history. Muse controls ultra availability.

entries.title: Welcome to Talos
entries.markdown:
- A new identity across your phone, browser, desktop, and terminal.
- Bronze accents, warm light surfaces, and a focused dark theme.
- Connect your terminal with `talos` and keep your agents within reach.
- Pair your devices securely and control which server they connect to.
